_doc: Real-robot stage 1: docking only. Same arena, markers and dock as arena_lab.json (extends). Put the robot 1.0 m from the dock marker's face, on (0.5, 1.0), facing -y (towards marker 0): it drives to W3 and docks. python main.py --real --task config/stage1_dock.json
_start: m and rad in {W}: where the robot is put, 1.0 m from the dock marker's face, facing it (see _doc)
